scope.2026_status: No circulating cent issued; production ended November 12, 2025.

universal_error_checks.name: Off-center strike
universal_error_checks.instruction: Look for missing design with a matching blank crescent. Value depends heavily on percent off-center and whether the date remains visible.

universal_error_checks.name: Clipped planchet
universal_error_checks.instruction: Look for a curved or straight missing section with Blakesley-effect weakness opposite the clip.

universal_error_checks.name: Broadstrike
universal_error_checks.instruction: Look for an expanded coin struck outside the retaining collar; distinguish it from post-mint damage.

universal_error_checks.name: Double or multiple strike
universal_error_checks.instruction: Look for a second displaced design impression. Do not confuse with machine doubling or damage.

universal_error_checks.name: Wrong planchet / off-metal
universal_error_checks.instruction: Measure weight, diameter, color, and magnetism. Valuable candidates require professional authentication.

universal_error_checks.name: Die cap or brockage
universal_error_checks.instruction: Look for a mirrored incuse design or bottle-cap shape caused during striking; authenticate before valuation.
